items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I didn't want to go to Sumner... So I had to explain because the difference in going to Sumner and to Lincoln is tuition and books

ctx.x: It still existed and we were victims of it so I didn't want to go to Sumner. And a little incident happened at the football game and I didn't like the sportsmanship, my idea of good teams. So, something happened to the sportsmanship I didn't like, I said, "I don't want to go to that school." So I had to explain because the difference in going to Sumner and to Lincoln is tuition and books and you know all that sort of thing.
How far away would Sumner be?
